BinaryBody.description: Binary bodies flow through the file gateway. This only describes their wire format.

authored_from.description: Upload time range (AI-DO: the source authored time).

document_type.description: A content type or its prefix (AI-DO: the source document type).

page.description: One-based page. The product of `page` and `page_size` must be at most 100.

query.description: Search text containing at least one non-whitespace character.

strategy.description:
Searches file names and metadata. Legacy requests that omit this field
default to `hybrid` and receive HTTP 422, as do explicit `semantic` and `hybrid` requests.

parent_id.description: miy (보강): move under another folder (`null` = the space root).

user_id.description: The caller (for the share editor's "you" marker).

original_path.description: The folder path the item was in (`""` for the space root).

status.description:
`reserving`, `uploading`, `ready` (all bytes stored), `completed`
(the file shows this version) or `cancelled`.

file_id.description: miy (versions): upload a new version of this file.
